summary: App should allow admin account signup/login without requiring a special admin signup password.
architectural_notes: Admin account creation should not require a separate "special signup password" gate; remove any related validation and UI messaging.
known_issues: Admin special signup password requirement/message is still present; user requested it be removed and rebuilt.

existing_features.title: Remove any user-facing UI text and error messaging that states or implies admins require a special signup password (including: "Admin accounts require a special signup password. Contact your system administrator if you don't have it.").

new_feature_requests.summary: Remove the special admin signup password requirement/check for admin accounts (and remove related UI message).
Remove the special admin signup password requirement from the backend so that creating an admin account no longer requires providing a separate admin signup password.
